blocks.orig: Karatu is a village between Lake Manyara National Park and the Ngorongoro Conservation Area. Discover its streets together with your guide, visit the market, buy handmade souvenirs, or do as the locals do and order lunch at one of the local mamas.  Our guides know all the nice spots that you would not normally discover as a tourist. So let the guide take you along, and have a super fun afternoon!
blocks.html: Between Lake Manyara National Park and the Ngorongoro Conservation Area lies the village of Karatu. Explore its streets with your guide, wander around the market, pick up handmade souvenirs, or follow the locals and have lunch at one of the local mamas.  Our guides know all the great spots you would normally miss as a visitor. So let your guide show you around, and have a really fun afternoon!
